reply.answer_text: No. The same processor cannot check their own payment case. The rule is 'maker ≠ checker' — the person who processes the payment must be different from the person who checks it. Both must independently re-check the evidence and recalculate the figure. This is called four-eyes, and it applies to any payment out, any change of bank mandate, any beneficiary or trustee change, any claim assessment, any redress calculation, and any manual override of a system figure.
